# Atlassian

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/atlassian.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Companies](../README.md#companies)

Enterprise and forward-deployed AI · International · Loop reviewed 2026-09-26

Separate official handbooks cover general engineering and product roles, not additional AI stages. Both are from Atlassian; independent corroboration is absent.

On this page: [Interview loop](#loop) · [Official preparation material](#prep) · [Questions (0)](#questions)

## Roles covered

- **AI Engineering:** Software engineer (general interview baseline)
- **AI Leadership:** Product manager (general interview baseline)

## <a id="loop"></a>Interview loop

| Stage | What happens | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Engineering coding | Two areas: data structures and code design. Explain reasoning and trade-offs in your chosen language. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Atlassian engineering interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/interviewing/engineering), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Engineering system design | Explore architecture under constraints, including reliability and cost; follow-up questions change the problem. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Atlassian engineering interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/interviewing/engineering), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Engineering manager conversation and review | Discuss experience and mindset with a manager. After interviewer feedback, an independent hiring committee reviews the evidence. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Atlassian engineering interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/interviewing/engineering), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Product-management loop | After the hiring manager: three interviews on influence, product craft and outcomes, plus a values interview. Communication is assessed throughout. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Atlassian product interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/career-growth/product-managers), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26 |

**Coding:** varies by role. Engineering includes coding; the product handbook specifies a different assessment. ([Atlassian engineering interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/interviewing/engineering), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26, [Atlassian product interview handbook](https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers/resources/career-growth/product-managers), Atlassian, retrieved 2026-09-26)
